parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number. Defaults to the first page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many tasks to return per page.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Return only tasks in this state. waiting and queued are not started yet, processing is running, completed has a downloadable result, failed carries an error, cancelled was stopped by you, and expired means the result has been cleaned up.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Return only tasks of this kind: cad for a single operation, model for a registered parametric model, convert-simple and convert-advanced for STEP conversions, pipeline for a chained run, compound for a parallel run.
